description: Get the reference documentation for a specific amCharts 5 chart type. A reference longer than 12,000 characters comes as an overview: its first parts in full and a list of the others, each of which get_section returns. With `full: true` it is the whole file. The chart type keywords are listed by list_chart_types.

full.description: true: the whole reference, however long. false (default): an overview when it is long.

name: get_chart_reference
title: Get chart reference
